Overview

Rishon LeZion is a city in Tel Aviv with a population of 255,000. Israel’s fourth-largest city, a suburb of Tel Aviv known for its wineries and high quality of life. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
